## Custom Content Text Editor - Call To Action


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000079206

Navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage >> Top Hero Section >> Search Box / Call to Action  > Click on Select Call to Action. Select the Custom Content - Text Editor option:

Click to Toggle Text Editor:

Lastly,  you can add all of the content needed:
